items: Marketing, Sales, Finance and HR rebuilt with 27 skills from Anthropic's Small Business pack (plus 5 chained helpers), installed in free / open-source mode — no paid connectors, CSV / XLSX exports and local files instead
asimo-marketing now has four branches — strategy & brand, content & social, video production (existing stack), paid & reputation
asimo-ceo stays the only router; the pack's own router is not installed

End-to-end test of the whole research chain (14 stages) with a Claude Science check at every stage — 11 pass, 3 partial; Science reproduced every number from Claude Code (Washburn depth, Pareto front, power n=7, response-surface R² 0.944)
Science skills: local drafts cannot be loaded by Science's skill tool, so every handoff brief tells Science to read the skill text directly — skills stay on this Mac

Fixes from the test: newton mass-balance limit on penetration + ageing-based durability claim, DOE power check, headless statistics CLI, DOI checks for non-CrossRef agencies, CORDIS FP7 + partner countries, patent pre-screen top-up

Claude Science joins asimo-rd as the compute layer — Claude Code orchestrates (routing, newton, lens, DOE), Claude Science runs the heavy work in sandboxed Python/R kernels and returns verified notebooks + publication figures
One skill source: newton + K-Dense skills synced from ~/.claude/skills into Claude Science as local drafts (never published); asimo-* skills come from the claude.ai account in both
Science MCP tools registered in Claude Code too: PubChem/ChEBI, OpenAlex/arXiv, PubMed — generic queries only, no Kalekim codes or names
File-based handoff: rd-handoff/brief.md in → Science kernels → results/summary.md back to statistical-analysis and newton
Jev (TypeSafe System One) pre-screen under lens-research: every OpenAlex / PubMed / patent-list candidate gets a 0–4 relevance Score in ~0.8 s; Fable reads only the survivors (−82…86% reading load)
Rule: public abstracts only — Asana, Gmail, Drive and any Kalekim document never go to Jev; those need a local model
manim linked to asimo-rd (ask-first rule for scientific visuals); still under asimo-marketing for video

K-Dense skills wired: scientific-brainstorming (ceo idea test), hypothesis-generation / experimental-design / statistical-power / pymoo (newton toolkit), statistical-analysis (rd), scientific-critical-thinking (rd + strategist), citation-management (lens)

Research chain is now 7 steps: sci → hypothesis-generation → newton + pymoo → lens-research + DOI validation → experimental-design + statistical-power → eu-project-research → academic-shield, results back via statistical-analysis
stickman-video-director under asimo-marketing: source + ratio + theme gate → Phase A director proposal (approval) → Phase B six Gemini Omni Flash prompts → OpenMontage assembly
gate-analysis under asimo-portfolio: Asana project × five-gate innovation audit, role fit, unrecorded closures, HTML + PDF
newton under asimo-rd: physics referee (JKR, Kendall, Dahlquist, WLF…), polymer ranking, DOE Excel
Research chain is now 5 steps: sci → newton → lens → eu → academic-shield
eu-project-research under asimo-rd (CORDIS, M-ERA.NET, EUREKA; partners, sites, funding, gap analysis)
archify owned by asimo-portfolio: maps all skills, agents, jobs
OpenMontage moved to Design/OpenMontage, global skill for all video work

Hierarchy: asimo-rd → asimo-sci → lens-research → academic-shield; asimo-marketing → manim · OpenMontage · TopView · Higgsfield; asimo-software (subsystem) → gstack · security; asimo-portfolio ← Asana + Obsidian, daily
